author: The Infographics Show
description:
Operation Epic Fury exploded to life on February 28, 2026, marking the start of a high intensity air campaign to dismantle the Iranian regime’s military capabilities. In a tightly coordinated "time-on-target" strike, hundreds of U.S. and Israeli aircraft converged to solve a decades-old problem to penetrate one of the world's most dense integrated air defense networks.

Today's epic video breaks down the strategic blueprint used to achieve total air superiority in just 72 hours. From the opening cyber attacks that de-synced Iran’s long-range sensors to the debut of the "Black Tomahawk" and the supersonic PrSM (Precision Strike Missile), we explore how 4th and 5th-generation jets worked in tandem to ground the Iranian Air Force. The US crippled Iran's air forces, but could this be just the beginning of more strikes?
